pages./zephyr-cell:
Zephyr cell

The Zephyr cell stores 410 Wh per kilogram at room temperature.

History

The Zephyr cell was first produced in Halvard in 2031 by Orrin Labs.
pages./zephyr-recycling:
Recycling

Orrin Labs recovers 93 percent of Zephyr cell lithium through a cold-leach process.
pages./kestrel-bridge:
Kestrel Bridge

The Kestrel Bridge spans 2.7 kilometres across the Marrow estuary.

Its main towers are 188 metres tall.
pages./kestrel-tolls:
Tolls

Crossing the Kestrel Bridge costs 4 florins for cars and is free for bicycles.

pages./quill-moth:
Quill moth

The quill moth has a wingspan of 14 millimetres.

It feeds only on silverbrush nectar.
pages./quill-moth-range:
Range

Quill moths live above 2,300 metres in the Tessaly highlands and migrate each October.
pages./orrin-labs:
Orrin Labs

Orrin Labs was founded by Mara Vesk and employs 1,240 people.

Its headquarters are in Pellam.
pages./orrin-funding:
Funding

Orrin Labs raised 310 million florins in its 2036 round, led by Calder Fund.
pages./marrow-estuary:
Marrow estuary

The Marrow estuary has a tidal range of 6.4 metres.

Its salt marsh covers 5,800 hectares.
pages./marrow-ferry:
Ferries

Before the bridge, the Grell ferry crossed the Marrow estuary in 35 minutes.
pages./halvard-transit:
Halvard transit

Halvard's tram network has 11 lines.

A day pass costs 7 florins.
pages./halvard-metro:
Metro plans

Halvard plans a driverless metro line opening in 2044 with 14 stations.
